robot-live-dashboard.title: Robot Live Dashboard
contribution: Worked on the display layout, live data showcase and the robot API connections.
robot-live-dashboard.summary: A real-time dashboard for observing robot activity, status and telemetry from a focused web interface.
robot-live-dashboard.challenge: Make a stream of robot events easy to monitor without losing the current operational context.
robot-live-dashboard.solution: The dashboard turns incoming updates into an at-a-glance interface for tracking state and activity as they change.

municipal-help-center-frontend.title: Municipal Help Center Frontend
contribution: Implemented the Ticket Detail agent view
Helped to improve the Ticket Inbox page with new features and visuals
Implemented the register/login pages
municipal-help-center-frontend.summary: A web application that brings independently developed services together behind one cohesive user experience.
municipal-help-center-frontend.challenge: Connect multiple application services while keeping the client experience consistent and the integration boundaries clear.
municipal-help-center-frontend.solution: A component-based frontend coordinates the application flows and consumes the team's service APIs through reusable integration layers.

municipal-help-center-backend.title: Municipal Help Center Backend
contribution: Helped in backend tasks to reduce team workload
Provided SQL queries to quickly find important data or to modify things in tables
municipal-help-center-backend.summary: A backend service for managing citizen requests, complaints and reports across a modular municipal platform.
municipal-help-center-backend.challenge: Coordinate ticket lifecycles, assignments and cross-module interactions while preserving a clear service contract for the frontend.
municipal-help-center-backend.solution: A layered Spring Boot API models the help-center domain and provides secure, persistence-backed endpoints for operational workflows.

mobile-auctions.title: Mobile Auctions
contribution: Implemented the register/login screens, the main dashboard screen, the auction detail screen, the live auction screen and the checkout screen
Implemented WebSockets in backend for actual live auctions
mobile-auctions.summary: A mobile marketplace experience for browsing auctions, viewing listings and participating from a phone.
mobile-auctions.challenge: Translate a multi-step auction flow into an interface that remains clear and comfortable on small screens.
mobile-auctions.solution: A mobile-first application organizes discovery, item details and bidding into focused, reusable screens.

mental-math-challenge.title: Mental Math Challenge
mental-math-challenge.summary: A mobile reaction game that puts your brain to the test by giving random math questions, with little time to answer.
mental-math-challenge.challenge: Build responsive game interactions where timing, feedback and a simple replay loop all feel immediate.
mental-math-challenge.solution: A compact mobile game uses timed state changes and touch input to calculate and present each result.

reaction-challenge.title: Reaction Challenge
reaction-challenge.summary: A mobile reaction game that measures response time through quick, touch-driven challenges.
reaction-challenge.challenge: Build responsive game interactions where timing, feedback and a simple replay loop all feel immediate.
reaction-challenge.solution: A compact mobile game uses timed state changes and touch input to calculate and present each result.

tic-tac-toe-mobile.title: Tic-Tac-Toe Mobile
tic-tac-toe-mobile.summary: A touch-friendly take on the classic two-player game, built around a clean mobile interaction loop.
tic-tac-toe-mobile.challenge: Model turns, win conditions and resets while keeping game feedback instantly understandable.
tic-tac-toe-mobile.solution: The application manages the board as predictable UI state and clearly communicates turns and outcomes.

aerial-pursuit-simulation.title: Aerial Pursuit Simulation
contribution: Worked on the page's frontend to display the simulated data given by the other teams
aerial-pursuit-simulation.summary: A computational model that explores the changing positions and outcome of an aerial pursuit scenario.
aerial-pursuit-simulation.challenge: Represent movement and pursuit rules precisely enough to study how the system evolves over time.
aerial-pursuit-simulation.solution: The simulation applies a repeatable set of model assumptions and visualizes the resulting trajectories for analysis.

szafrankus-store-frontend.title: Szafrankus Store Frontend
contribution: Worked on the creator/admin screens
Improved other screens by giving new designs and adding new features
szafrankus-store-frontend.summary: A responsive frontend that turns remote API data into an approachable, interactive browsing experience.
szafrankus-store-frontend.challenge: Coordinate asynchronous data, user actions and loading states without making the interface feel fragmented.
szafrankus-store-frontend.solution: Reusable interface components organize API-backed content and provide clear feedback across the main user flows.

szafrankus-store-backend.title: Szafrankus Store Backend
contribution: Helped with the building of entities
Worked on the controllers, services and endpoint testing
szafrankus-store-backend.summary: The service layer for an interactive application, designed to expose structured data through clear endpoints.
szafrankus-store-backend.challenge: Provide a dependable contract between the user-facing client and the application data.
szafrankus-store-backend.solution: A REST-oriented backend centralizes request handling, domain rules and persistence for the companion frontend.

polyglot-persistence-system.title: Polyglot Persistence E-Commerce
contribution: Worked live alongside my team to build the code
polyglot-persistence-system.summary: An order and inventory system that assigns each data concern to the database model best suited to it.
polyglot-persistence-system.challenge: Keep products, stock, payments and relationships consistent while working across several NoSQL technologies.
polyglot-persistence-system.solution: A Java application coordinates purpose-specific persistence layers backed by document, graph, key-value and wide-column databases.

sago-dental-management.title: SAGO Dental Management
contribution: Built most of the frontend myself
Connected and hosted Firebase DB
sago-dental-management.summary: A dental practice platform for managing patients, appointments and clinical tools from one web application.
sago-dental-management.challenge: Bring administrative and clinical workflows together without making everyday patient management cumbersome.
sago-dental-management.solution: A React interface combines authentication, patient search, appointment scheduling and periodontal chart access with Firebase services.

restaurant-ordering-system.title: Restaurant Ordering System
contribution: Main architech of the program by constantly providing updates on the UML
Worked live alongside my team to build the code
restaurant-ordering-system.summary: A Java domain model for a restaurant workflow spanning menus, orders, discounts, payments, notifications and invoicing.
restaurant-ordering-system.challenge: Translate a broad set of business requirements into a cohesive object model with explicit responsibilities and extension points.
restaurant-ordering-system.solution: The design uses UML, interfaces, inheritance, adapters and factories, with JSON persistence for menu data.

snake-game.title: Snake Game
contribution: Crafted the inicial snake logic
Implemented the snake visuals
Implemented special abilites when eating food
snake-game.summary: A desktop implementation of Snake with scoring, game-state management and persistent score records.
snake-game.challenge: Coordinate movement, collisions, rendering and timed input while keeping the game model separated into clear objects.
snake-game.solution: A Java Swing application organizes gameplay around reusable domain classes, inheritance, interfaces and file-based persistence.

coderhouse-react-final.title: React E-commerce
coderhouse-react-final.summary: A complete storefront with product discovery, cart state and a guided checkout experience.
coderhouse-react-final.challenge: Bring routing, shared state and asynchronous catalogue data together in a cohesive single-page application.
coderhouse-react-final.solution: The storefront uses reusable React components and centralized cart behavior to support the purchase journey.

coderhouse-backend-one.title: Backend I Final Project
coderhouse-backend-one.summary: An e-commerce API covering products, carts and the server-side foundations of an online store.
coderhouse-backend-one.challenge: Move storefront responsibilities into a maintainable server with clear resources and persistence.
coderhouse-backend-one.solution: A Node.js API defines modular routes and data access for catalogue and cart operations.

coderhouse-backend-two.title: Backend II Final Project
coderhouse-backend-two.summary: An expanded commerce backend with authentication, authorization and production-oriented API patterns.
coderhouse-backend-two.challenge: Evolve a working API to support identity, protected actions and clearer separation of concerns.
coderhouse-backend-two.solution: The project layers authentication and role-aware business flows onto a modular Node.js service.

electives-filtrator-2000.title: Electives Filtrator 2000
electives-filtrator-2000.summary: A small utility that helps UADE Computer Engineering students discover and filter elective subjects.
electives-filtrator-2000.challenge: Turn a difficult-to-scan set of electives into a quicker, criteria-driven decision tool.
electives-filtrator-2000.solution: A purpose-built interface makes the available options searchable and easier to compare.

forecast-assignment-validator.title: Forecast Assignment Validator
forecast-assignment-validator.summary: An automation utility for validating forecast assignments and surfacing inconsistencies before they become manual rework.
forecast-assignment-validator.challenge: Replace repetitive checks across assignment data with a consistent and auditable validation step.
forecast-assignment-validator.solution: The tool evaluates records against defined rules and produces focused output for the cases that need attention.

jira-people-report-generator.title: Jira People Report Generator
jira-people-report-generator.summary: A reporting utility that converts Jira people data into a practical view for operational follow-up.
jira-people-report-generator.challenge: Make account and people information easier to review than scattered records and one-off manual checks.
jira-people-report-generator.solution: The generator collects and reshapes Jira data into a repeatable report designed around review workflows.

nehuelmarcos-portfolio.title: nehuelmarcos.com
nehuelmarcos-portfolio.summary: This evolving portfolio: a considered home for my engineering journey, experience and project work.
nehuelmarcos-portfolio.challenge: Present a growing body of work with enough structure to be useful without losing a distinct personal voice.
nehuelmarcos-portfolio.solution: A custom React site combines editorial layouts, data-driven pages and responsive navigation in a lightweight build.
